rules.name: unsafe fn from_raw_parts_in (ptr : * mut T , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rules.rule: Nothing else may use ptr after calling from_raw_parts_in.

rules.name: unsafe fn from_parts_in (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rules.rule: ptr must be currently allocated via the given allocator alloc.

rules.name: unsafe fn from_parts_in (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rules.rule: The alignment of T must equal the alignment with which ptr was allocated.

rules.name: unsafe fn from_parts_in (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rules.rule: The size of T multiplied by capacity must equal the size in bytes with which ptr was allocated.

rules.name: unsafe fn from_parts_in (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rules.rule: length must be less than or equal to capacity.

rules.name: unsafe fn from_parts_in (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rules.rule: The first length values at ptr must be properly initialized values of type T.

rules.name: unsafe fn from_parts_in (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rules.rule: capacity must fit the layout size with which ptr was allocated.

rules.name: unsafe fn from_parts_in (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rules.rule: The allocated size in bytes must be no larger than isize::MAX.

rules.name: unsafe fn from_parts_in (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rules.rule: Nothing else may use ptr after calling from_parts_in.

rules.name: unsafe fn set_len (& mut self , new_len : usize)
rules.rule: The new length must be less than or equal to the vector's capacity.

rules.name: unsafe fn set_len (& mut self , new_len : usize)
rules.rule: All elements from the vector's old length up to, but not including, the new length must be initialized.
